modalities.evidence: de-identified fMRI and T1-weighted imaging data
Test-retest reliability of resting-state functional MRI during DBS

output.population: Parkinson's disease patients (aged 50-76 years) receiving deep brain stimulation therapy, implanted in the subthalamic nucleus or globus pallidus internus
output.summary: Test-retest resting-state fMRI and T1-weighted imaging from Parkinson's disease patients receiving deep brain stimulation of the subthalamic nucleus or globus pallidus internus, with stimulation-off and stimulation-on runs, acquired at UCSF.
